testo:
Triple Breaker
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, choose 2 of your opponent's creatures and put them into their owner's mana zone. You may use all abilities that start with "When you put this creature into the battle zone" as if they were your creatures.
testo_jp:
Triple Breaker
■ このクリーチャーがバトルゾーンに出た時、相手のクリーチャーを2体選び、持ち主のマナゾーンに置く。それらの「このクリーチャーがバトルゾーンに出た時」で始まる能力をすべて、自分のクリーチャーであるかのように使ってもよい。
